# is unconfirmed (plan R13).  Every test that reads this file carries
# @pytest.mark.unverified_fixture, which is a provenance label and never a skip.

# The counts are the sample's own and are NOT internally consistent
# (11/0/2/11 reports 11 free out of 11 total with 2 running); they are
# preserved verbatim rather than corrected, because a fixture that "fixes"
# its source stops being evidence of anything.

#   slist | tee tests/fixtures/slist.txt
